# OVL — Overlay

- Owner: `ticonnect-overlay`
- Stage: 8
- Layer: `clients`
- Component graph: [generated/components/ovl.md](generated/components/ovl.md)

## Purpose

Own corner toast cards, card queue, deduplication, Wayland layer-shell surface, X11 fallback, notifications fallback, and UI activation.

## Boundary

Client process. Subscribes to daemon signals and settings. Does not depend on UI or daemon internals.

## Owned state

- card queue
- visible card state

## Invariants

- `INV-STAGE-1` — Every stage demo uses only components from that stage or earlier stages. Test: cargo xtask systems --check

## Failure semantics

- never steal focus
- deduplicate by message id
- fallback to system notifications
- respect policy and DND

## Open decisions

- call and transfer card extension points land in Stages 10 and 9
- Wayland uses the compositor monitor and X11 uses the first monitor
